slides.texte_overlay:
5 words that will
make you sound
effortlessly well read

Effervescent:
bubbly, lively and
full of enthusiasm
(ef-er-VES-uhnt)

Example:
Her effervescent mood
made the long day
feel short.

Gregarious:
fond of company,
sociable
(gri-GAIR-ee-uhs)

Example:
She was gregarious and
knew everyone at
the party.

Circumspect:
careful to weigh every
risk before acting
(SUR-kuhm-spekt)

Example:
She stayed circumspect
and read the contract
twice.

Quixotic:
idealistic in a way
that is not practical
(kwik-SOT-ik)

Example:
Her plan to read every
book in the library
was quixotic.

Polymath:
someone who knows a lot
about many subjects
(POL-ee-math)

Example:
She became a quiet
polymath, learning a little
history, art and science
every day.
